decision.summary: A multi-sample negative offset in U begins ~628, coincides with a smaller positive E shift, and lacks a clear opposing return before index 670; N shows only a transient feature. The sustained interior and incomplete recovery prevent confirmation of a temporary platform; status is uncertain.

intervals.observation: U-component shows a sharp downward step starting at ~628, sustained through ~635 (minimum near 632), then a slow partial recovery; E-component rises modestly (~3 MAD) from ~628 to ~633 and remains elevated until ~642; N-component exhibits only a transient spike at ~628 with no persistent offset. Return is incomplete and ambiguous beyond 642 within allowed context.
